mainEntity.name: How does AEO help my pest control business get more leads?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO boosts leads by making your pest control business the authoritative answer when potential customers ask questions online. When your content appears as a featured snippet or is read aloud by a voice assistant, it significantly increases visibility and establishes trust. This positions your company as the go-to expert. Users are more likely to click through to a business that has already provided a helpful, direct answer to their initial query, leading to higher quality leads who are further along in their decision-making process. It’s about being present at the precise moment a customer needs an answer and a solution.
